note: Which chart an artifact's EXTENSION sends it to. Added 2026-08-04 to close the router seam. The chart manifest (seed/CHARTS.json) said adding a chart takes 'a manifest row plus (if the behavior is new) three registered functions - no dispatch edit', and that was true for addressing and false for ROUTING: engine/router.py keyed Lean off a hardcoded `name.endswith('.lean')`, so no manifest row could ever route a file anywhere. This file is the missing half. Shape follows adapters/language_registry.py on claude/repo-intake-adapter, but it is wired into engine/router.py itself rather than into a parallel adapter path, because a second intake path is a second set of rules to keep in agreement.

classes.chart: enters the named chart on the strength of its extension alone, before any content rule. `chart` must name a chart declared in seed/CHARTS.json.
classes.classify: content decides - transcript, table, or prose. This is what every non-Lean artifact did before this manifest existed.
classes.reference: READ AND COUNTED, NEVER INGESTED. A held language: the engine has no chart for it, and saying so with a count is the honest form of that. Silently walking past the file is not.

rules.why: no python chart exists. Standing one up needs a CHARTS.json row (tag `py`, behavior `python`) AND a normalizer, classifier and segmenter, which are dict literals in engine/normalize.py and engine/extract.py - there is no registration API. 1,405 files in the operator's repositories are held here.

the DEFAULT, declared here rather than hidden in code. An artifact with no extension - a chat message id like `claude||<uuid>:3` - is classified by content, which is exactly what the router did before this manifest existed. Silence in the manifest therefore changes nothing.
